svg.aria-label: How the corners are smoothed: each corner of the regular octagon (grey) is replaced by an arc of the hyperbola that is tangent to the two sides at the corner and has the lines of the next two sides as asymptotes. For the upper right corner: the hyperbola (dashed orange), its asymptotes y = 1 and x − y = √2 meeting at its centre C, the tangency points T₁ and T₂ and the cut-off corner (shaded); the straight part left of each side is 1/√2 of it
